remove_comments.description: Enable removal of HTML comments (except those starting with '!')

remove_empty_space.description: Remove empty space between tags only if a newline occurs within the space

remove_all_empty_space.description: Remove all empty space between tags (use with caution)

keep_optional_attribute_quotes.description: Keep optional attribute quotes even if they are not required

in_head.description: Set if parsing an HTML fragment located in the head of the document

keep_pre_attr.description: Keep the proprietary 'pre' attribute in the final output

pre_attr.description: Name of the attribute that marks HTML blocks to be excluded from minification

pre_tags.description: List of tag names whose content should not be minified. Script and style are always excluded.

encoding.description: Character encoding used for reading input and writing output files
